title: Dead Drop
summary: November 4 availability: the public landing page loads, but the Hunt screen stays at “reading the stones” and its contract read returns HTTP 404. The documented epoch-13031 target and October 31 walkthrough are historical; they do not establish a working post-reset hunt. No wallet, funding or claim action was performed. David J’s riddle-and-stealth-output app combines an encrypted memo, answer-derived signing key and time conditions. Correct answers decrypt locally; claiming and returning funds require transactions. Public riddles can be guessed offline, first valid claim wins, and browser-stored keys need a backup. The Midnight Grave uses epoch 13031; the creator revised its estimated opening to early November rather than a fixed Halloween time. October 31 review covered the source, original announcement and public landing page. The recording shows the public explanation only; no funding, claim or return was attempted. This is a separate community project from the Workbench Dead Drop social-deduction game. November 2 organizer notice: Esmeralda testnet was reset; entrants were asked to republish templates and update their submission versions where applicable. Earlier recordings document their capture dates.
cardSummary: Explore riddle-locked messages and testnet tokens with timed claims and refunds for unclaimed drops.
